name: world-units-of-measure
title: Units of measure (UN/ECE Recommendation 20)
description: The UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20 codes for units of measure used in international trade (Revision 17), with names, symbols, conversion factors to SI units as published and as numbers, the physical quantities each unit is listed under, and unit sets (count, mass, volume, length, area, energy) with the factor of each unit to the set's base unit.

sources.title: UN/CEFACT Recommendation No. 20, Codes for Units of Measure Used in International Trade, Revision 17 (2021), rec20_Rev17e-2021.xlsx, UNECE
Copy of the same file (sources/rec20-rev17.xlsx, 305,526 bytes) in the mskvarc/cefact-units repository, used for retrieval on 2026-11-09 because unece.org blocks scripted downloads

fields.name: code
fields.description: Rec 20 common code, two or three characters (KGM, C62, 2U).

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the unit in English as published.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Description as published; empty when Rec 20 gives none.

fields.name: level_category
fields.description: Rec 20 level/category: level 1 (1, 1S, 1M) SI normative units and commonly used multiples; level 2 (2, 2S) normative equivalents such as UK and US units; level 3 (3, 3.1 to 3.9) informative units found only in Annexes II and III. Several categories are separated by semicolons.

fields.name: symbol
fields.description: Symbol as published; empty when Rec 20 gives none.

fields.name: conversion_factor
fields.description: Conversion factor to SI units exactly as published, for example '10⁻³ kg' or '0,453 592 37 kg'. Empty when Rec 20 gives none.

fields.name: factor
fields.description: conversion_factor as a number when it is a plain multiple of one unit (mantissa, power of ten, unit): 10⁻³ kg gives 0.001. Empty when the factor is an expression (products, offsets such as degrees Celsius) or absent.

fields.name: factor_unit
fields.description: The SI unit factor refers to (kg, m³, m, J, kg/m³). Empty for pure numbers such as dozen (12) and when factor is empty.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Rec 20 status: empty for an active code, X for a code marked for deletion, D for a deprecated code.

fields.name: sector_number
fields.description: Annex I sector number, two digits (01 Space and Time, 03 Mechanics).

fields.name: sector
fields.description: Annex I sector name.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Physical quantity the unit is listed under in Annex I, as published (mass, volume, area). Empty for five energy-per-volume units (KWN, KWS, MNJ, Q41, Q42) that Annex I lists without a quantity.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Unit code. References code in units.

fields.name: set
fields.description: Unit set: count (base C62 one), mass (base KGM kilogram), volume (base MTQ cubic metre), length (base MTR metre), area (base MTK square metre) or energy (base JOU joule).

fields.name: code
fields.description: Unit code. References code in units.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the unit, copied from units.

fields.name: symbol
fields.description: Symbol of the unit, copied from units.

fields.name: level_category
fields.description: Level/category, copied from units: use 1, 1S and 1M for metric units and 2 for UK and US units.

fields.name: factor_to_base
fields.description: How many base units one of this unit is: gram 0.001 (kg), tonne 1000 (kg), litre 0.001 (m³), dozen 12. Quantity in base unit = quantity × factor_to_base.

fields.name: is_base
fields.description: true for the base unit of the set (factor 1).
